references.text: Psalm 126:2-3 describes great joy and rejoicing among the Lord's people, reflecting the joy and rejoicing foretold in Luke 1:14 over the birth of John the Baptist.
Isaiah 35:10 speaks of the joy and gladness that will come with salvation, parallel to the joy foretold at John's birth in Luke 1:14.
Luke 2:10-11, where the angel announces Jesus' birth, brings great joy, similar to the joy foretold for John's birth in Luke 1:14.
In Matthew 21:9, the people's joy and shouts of 'Hosanna' as Jesus rides into Jerusalem can be seen in light of the expected joy at John's birth in Luke 1:14.
